mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(1) FROM tb_order o LEFT JOIN tb_event e ON e.id = o.event_id

SELECT o.id AS id, o.status AS status, CASE WHEN o.status = 1 THEN '未支付' WHEN o.status = 2 THEN '已取消' WHEN o.status = 3 THEN '已完成订单' WHEN o.status = 4 THEN '申请退款中' WHEN o.status = 5 THEN '异常订单' WHEN o.status = 6 THEN '未检票' WHEN o.status = 7 THEN '已退票' ELSE '未知状态' END AS statusText, o.pay_price AS totalAmount, o.quantity AS quantity, DATE_FORMAT(o.create_time, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS createTime, DATE_FORMAT(o.expire_time, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS expireTime, o.refund_reason AS refundReason, DATE_FORMAT(o.refund_apply_time, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS refundApplyTime, DATE_FORMAT(o.refund_audit_time, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS refundAuditTime, o.refund_reject_reason AS refundRejectReason, o.refund_operator_id AS refundOperatorId,
o.refund_status AS refundStatus, o.refund_step AS refundStep, o.refund_fail_step AS refundFailStep, o.refund_fail_reason AS refundFailReason, DATE_FORMAT(o.refund_return_time, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS refundReturnTime, DATE_FORMAT(o.refund_finish_time, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS refundFinishTime,
u.id AS userId, u.username AS username, u.phone AS phone, u.real_name AS realName,
e.id AS eventId, e.title AS eventTitle, e.poster_url AS posterUrl, e.city AS city, e.venue AS venue, e.allow_refund AS allowRefund,
s.id AS sessionId, s.session_name AS sessionName, DATE_FORMAT(s.show_time, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS showTime,
tc.id AS ticketCategoryId, tc.name AS ticketCategoryName, tc.price AS ticketPrice FROM tb_order o LEFT JOIN tb_user u ON u.id = o.user_id LEFT JOIN tb_event e ON e.id = o.event_id LEFT JOIN tb_ticket_category tc ON tc.id = o.ticket_id LEFT JOIN tb_event_session s ON s.id = COALESCE(o.session_id, tc.session_id)
ORDER BY o.create_time DESC LIMIT #{query.offset}, #{query.size}

SELECT o.id AS id, o.status AS status, CASE WHEN o.status = 1 THEN '已创建，未支付' WHEN o.status = 2 THEN '已取消' WHEN o.status = 3 THEN '已完成订单' WHEN o.status = 4 THEN '申请退款中' WHEN o.status = 5 THEN '异常订单' WHEN o.status = 6 THEN '已支付，未检票' WHEN o.status = 7 THEN '已退票' ELSE '未知状态' END AS statusText, o.pay_price AS totalAmount, o.quantity AS quantity, DATE_FORMAT(o.create_time, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS createTime, DATE_FORMAT(o.expire_time, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS expireTime, o.refund_reason AS refundReason, DATE_FORMAT(o.refund_apply_time, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS refundApplyTime, DATE_FORMAT(o.refund_audit_time, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS refundAuditTime, o.refund_reject_reason AS refundRejectReason, o.refund_operator_id AS refundOperatorId,
o.refund_status AS refundStatus, o.refund_step AS refundStep, o.refund_fail_step AS refundFailStep, o.refund_fail_reason AS refundFailReason, DATE_FORMAT(o.refund_return_time, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS refundReturnTime, DATE_FORMAT(o.refund_finish_time, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS refundFinishTime,
u.id AS userId, u.username AS username, u.phone AS phone, u.real_name AS realName,
e.id AS eventId, e.title AS eventTitle, e.poster_url AS posterUrl, e.city AS city, e.venue AS venue, e.allow_refund AS allowRefund,
s.id AS sessionId, s.session_name AS sessionName, DATE_FORMAT(s.show_time, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS showTime,
tc.id AS ticketCategoryId, tc.name AS ticketCategoryName, tc.price AS ticketPrice FROM tb_order o LEFT JOIN tb_user u ON u.id = o.user_id LEFT JOIN tb_event e ON e.id = o.event_id LEFT JOIN tb_event_session s ON s.id = o.session_id LEFT JOIN tb_ticket_category tc ON tc.id = o.ticket_id WHERE o.id = #{id} LIMIT 1
